sources.snippet: Model Card for smolvla SmolVLA is a compact, efficient vision-language-action model that achieves competitive performance at reduced computational costs and can be deployed on consumer-grade hardware. This policy has been trained and pushed to the Hub using LeRobot. See the full documentation at LeRobot Docs.
